name: Coreboot port for an Alder Lake motherboard

mentions.name: Coreboot port for an Alder Lake motherboard
mentions.description: This project ports coreboot to an Alder Lake motherboard. Current work focuses on decompiling and documenting Intel CSME 16 firmware as a step toward getting the coreboot port working.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on something similar for an Alder Lake motherboard to try to get coreboot ported. Right now I'm working through decompiling and documenting CSME 16 and it's a slog with guard rails limiting me to Opus 4.8.
mentions.author: MertsA
